title: C¹ approximation of real-valued Lipschitz functions (Simon Ch. 2, Theorem 1.5)
statement: For all n ∈ ℕ, K ≥ 0, every K-Lipschitz function f : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) and every ε ∈ (0, ∞], there is a function g : ℝⁿ → ℝ of class C¹ such that Lⁿ({x : f(x) ≠ g(x) or Df(x) ≠ Dg(x)}) < ε, where D is Mathlib's Fréchet derivative fderiv (0 at points of non-differentiability).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Rn n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K f → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ g : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ volume {x | f x ≠ g x ∨ fderiv ℝ f x ≠ fderiv ℝ g x} < ε
